_doc: The first co-op drill (openspec/changes/coop-drill design 1). Text is what the briefing and debrief show. enemy_start_m is relative to the Tern, in its frame (+Z ahead); waypoint_m is the relay at the Shoals, where the helm's COURSE flies, in the same frame. bot_ready_s is how long a bot client reads the briefing before it presses READY.
title: Drill 1: Hound at the Shoals
situation: A Hound corvette has been raiding the relay at the Shoals. The Tern is ordered to intercept and disable it before it reaches the relay.
objectives: Keep the Tern's hull above zero

orders.helm: Close to turret range. Keep the Hound level with the ship so all four turrets bear, put the bow on it for missiles, and keep moving so it cannot aim.
orders.tactical: Lock the Hound, free the turrets, turn the strongest shield toward it, and fire Gannets when the bow is on it.
orders.engineering: The Tern's power grid is not in this drill yet. Watch the board; your console comes alive when the grid is built.
orders.science: Scan the Hound so Tactical sees its hull, find its weapons' band and tune the shields to it, and keep the shields facing its fire.
orders.captain: Call red alert, keep the crew on task with orders, and take the viewscreen when everyone needs to see the same thing.
